From business requirements to a working system

I worked directly with ArtCoupe’s owner to translate production processes into software. As the sole developer, I designed the data model, built the applications and integrations, and handled deployment and production troubleshooting.

Project context

Contract work began in March 2023. The delivered system is used in production by a small furniture manufacturer, replacing separate spreadsheets with connected workflows.

04 / Engineering focus

Messaging under unreliable connectivity

A key challenge was keeping the corporate messenger responsive when mobile connectivity and third-party services were unreliable.

Android messenger with internal groups and connected external conversations.

Communication inside the business platform

Employee and group chats, media sharing, voice messages, transcription, search, pinned messages, and audio/video calls. Telegram and MAX integrations bring external conversations into the same working environment.

Challenge → implementation

Keep chat usable during network gaps

I added local message caching and a persistent outgoing queue. Cached history can appear before a network response; pending messages remain available for retry when connectivity returns.

Reduce reliance on one delivery path

I implemented an alternative push channel and self-hosted application update delivery to address regional connectivity restrictions. Delivery states and diagnostics help investigate failures without treating every delay as an application crash.

Connect affiliated companies

Cross-company conversations connect separate company deployments. The backend bridge signs requests and checks timestamps and signatures. Roles and configuration let each deployment adapt its workflows.

Read cached history
→
Store outgoing message
→
Send / retry online
→
Update delivery state

Engineering principle: separate local responsiveness from network delivery. Server-side Telegram integration supports working through the corporate client without requiring staff to use a VPN for that workflow; availability still depends on connectivity to the application and upstream services.

Audio and video with LiveKit / WebRTC

The backend authorizes calls and selects one media provider for both participants. A configured self-hosted primary can fall back to the cloud when a call starts, keeping signaling and provider selection coordinated.

05 / Data and automation

Adaptable workflows, synchronized files

I designed configurable business data and file workflows, then connected the platform to the tools employees already used.

Configurable data

Forms and permissions follow the process

Field definitions control labels, types, ordering, and presentation. Orders and extensions store dynamic values in PostgreSQL JSONB alongside relational identifiers.

Role-based access covers pages and individual parameters, including visibility, editing, and readiness checks. This supports different responsibilities within the same workflow.

FileSpace

Versioned storage with a desktop client

S3-compatible object storage supports shared folders, role-based access, file versions, trash, and an activity log.

The Electron client synchronizes a local Windows folder, handles conflicting changes, and stores the session token through Windows-protected storage. Storage credentials remain on the server.

Workflow automation / BAZIS

Approximately 35 JavaScript scripts for furniture design

I extended the BAZIS scripting environment to automate repetitive design and engineering work. One example creates shelves across selected cabinet sections using configurable inputs, replacing repeated manual operations.

BAZIS workspace and custom scripting tools.

From design completion to visibility

Another integration sends a design preview, timestamp, and specification context to Telegram when a manufacturing engineer completes the relevant work.

The work began with targeted automations and expanded into a centralized platform as the owner’s operational requirements grew.

Design tradeoff: configurable fields make workflow changes easier, while business rules, validation, and specialized integrations remain explicit application code.
